summary.text: An Esan LGA with its headquarters at Ubiaja. Its riverside Illushi ward on the Niger is Igala speaking: Ilushi, Uloshi land and the southern Ifeku villages (Allah-Ifeku II, Ifeku Island, Okwoshimili).

peoples.name: Igala (Ilushi, Uloshi, Ifeku)
peoples.note: Placed under Edo State by colonial and later boundary changes, but distinct from the Esan in language and custom. Ifeku spans the Etsako Central and Esan South-East boundary; three of its villages lie on this side.

livelihoods.text: Farming on fertile upland soils where yam thrives; the Esan traditionally settle on high ground between rivers. The riverside Igala of Ilushi fish and trade on the Niger.
